zh: 一小时五十块，我觉得挺合理的。
en: Fifty dollars an hour sounds {reasonable|fair} to me.

zh: 我今晚出不去了，我身无分文。
en: I can't come out tonight; I'm {broke|skint}.

zh: 奥克兰的房租真的很贵。
en: Rent in Auckland is really {expensive|high|pricey|dear}.

zh: 她现在有一份稳定的收入。
en: She has a {steady|stable|regular} income now.

zh: 我每月的房贷还款是两千块。
en: My {monthly} mortgage payment is two thousand dollars.

zh: 消费满五十块就免运费。
en: Delivery is {free} if you spend over fifty dollars.

zh: 这栋房子大约值一百万。
en: The house is {worth} about a million dollars.

zh: 他出身于一个富裕的家庭。
en: He comes from a {wealthy|rich} family.

zh: 这张信用卡的年费是九十块。
en: The {annual|yearly} fee for this credit card is ninety dollars.

zh: 买房之前，我需要一些财务方面的建议。
en: I need some {financial} advice before I buy a house.

zh: 我们选了两年的固定利率。
en: We chose a {fixed} interest rate for two years.

zh: 仔细看合同，可能有隐藏的费用。
en: Read the contract carefully; there may be {hidden} fees.

zh: 这个月手头有点紧。
en: Money is a bit {tight} this month.

zh: 她花钱很谨慎，从不浪费一分钱。
en: She's very {careful|good} with money; she never wastes a cent.

zh: 我们希望明年利率能更低。
en: We're hoping for {lower} interest rates next year.

zh: 你还有四十块的未付余额。
en: You still have an {outstanding|unpaid} balance of forty dollars.

zh: 把所有积蓄都投进一家公司是有风险的。
en: Putting all your savings into one company is {risky|dangerous}.

zh: 我周末打点工，多挣一点额外的钱。
en: I do some weekend work to earn a bit of {extra|additional} money.

zh: 不要把任何贵重的东西留在车里。
en: Don't leave anything {valuable|expensive} in the car.

zh: 买二手车是明智的选择。
en: Buying a used car was the {sensible|wise|smart} choice.
